description: This source file defines the onboarding interface and controller for the OpenClaw macOS application, including UI components, onboarding flow logic, and related state management.

classes.name: OnboardingController
classes.description: Manages the display, restart, and closure of the onboarding window, ensuring proper UI presentation based on environment conditions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the onboarding window, handling special cases like Nix mode and existing window instances.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the onboarding window if it exists.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the onboarding process by closing and then showing the window again.
